audit.family_definition: Exact Dhatupatha citation including markers, plus gana; not an etymological lemma split.
audit.scope: Full regeneration, semantic fields, all accepted gold variants, prompt identity, split membership and declared sampling exclusions.
audit.limits: Does not independently certify Sanskrit correctness, empirical difficulty, contamination absence or benchmark sampling precision.

reward: One extracted answer, NFC-normalized and stripped, must equal any accepted gold form. Binary 0/1. No thinking-block requirement or fuzzy credit.
model_input: Use only messages (or prompt). Keep gold fields and task metadata in the verifier, not the input.
training_integration: The legacy root-only VP prompt renderer omits these operations. Consume the exported prompts directly; no training configuration has been changed or launched.
limits: Exact citation-plus-gana split, not an etymological lemma split. Existing checkpoints are not certified clean. This export does not certify final benchmark difficulty or every generated key.
reason: 52 tasks use abhi rather than SLP1 aBi. Use the corrected replacement export.
